issues.description: Constructor parameter order for class Lecture differs between the problem statement (UML + instructions) and the provided solution. The problem statement/UML requires the constructor parameters in this order: (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). The solution implementation provides a constructor with this order: (String lectureName, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents) (see solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 13). This contradicts the explicit instruction to follow the UML parameter order and will confuse students implementing the constructor and may cause tests that expect the UML order to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the constructor in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java to declare parameters in the same order as the UML/instruction: (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). Update the constructor's assignment statements accordingly so each parameter initializes the matching field. Ensure any example usages or tests (and the solution README or comments) are updated to use the same parameter order so the template, documentation, tests, and solution are consistent.
